captions.detailed: This object is a sunroof assembly featuring a dark, matte black rectangular base frame with integrated parallel guide tracks. A square, semi-transparent blue glass sunroof panel is mounted in a thin black surround. The glass panel is designed to slide horizontally along the guide rails from its closed position to an open position.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a sunroof assembly. It should consist of a wide, flat black base frame with parallel guide rails, and a sliding square glass panel with a thin black border that moves along the rails using a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code defines a base frame using a thin box, adding parallel guide rails along the longitudinal axis. It then models a sliding sunroof panel consisting of a thin glass-colored box nested within a slightly larger, hollowed-out black frame. A prismatic joint is defined between the base frame and the sliding glass panel, allowing translation along the Y-axis.
